prompt:
ONE original square 1024x1024 premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of KARTIKEYA, the revered Hindu war god and commander of the gods.
ANATOMY: One youthful male deity, ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs. Fully opaque red-gold woven battle garments, modest covered torso. One large broad leaf-bladed VEL spear in his right hand. A living blue peacock Paravani close at his left flank, feathers distinct. [kartikeya-c06,c07,c08,c14]
MOMENT: Stride into battle toward the viewer with a commanding downward gaze; drive the vel diagonally forward into the extreme near foreground. Cloak and peacock feathers swept backwards by the advance, no gore. This is a commander leading an assault, not a youth posing on a hill.
POWER: No invented elemental attack or emitted magic. Authority from documented war command and the real spear; boot dislodges dry grit. [kartikeya-c09,c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; waist-to-head deity fills nearly the whole frame with foreshortened spear blade huge at lower foreground; perspective builds divine presence without invented giant body size. Peacock head visible beside him, not extra human limbs.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE strong golden sunset rim light behind the vel blade, low-key walnut shadows on face; dusty air catches this same light.
SURFACE: rough red-gold woven cloth, scratched ancient gold spear, detailed peacock feathers, skin real and warm.
SETTING: Kurinji hill country, dark crags immediately behind his commanding figure. [kartikeya-c05]
MOOD: awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented tradition, imposing and intense, never cute, placid or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; original design, no film/game/anime/comic references; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, magical symbols or energy ribbons.
